content: Hello, thank you for contacting Amazon Security. My name is Daniel, and I'm here to help you with your account today. May I have your full name for verification, please?
Yes, my name is Sunita Sharma.
Thank you, Ms. Sharma. I see a recent order on your account that's been delayed at customs. Before we continue, could you confirm the phone number on your Amazon account for security purposes?

Perfect, thank you. Now, regarding your order, customs has notified us that there is a regulatory fee pending. This is a standard Amazon policy for overseas shipments. I'll explain everything and guide you through the safe process.
Oh, I did not know about this. I just want my package. What do I need to do?
No worries, Ms. Sharma. This happens sometimes, and I will make sure your order gets to you. First, I need to check the billing address on your account. Can you please confirm it for me?
It is 42 Willow Road, Queens, NY, 11377.
Thank you. Everything matches. To move forward, we'll need to resolve the customs fee before your package can be released. This is a temporary payment, and Amazon will refund you after verification.
So I pay now and get money back? Sorry, I am not understanding how.

That's correct, once payment is received, it's processed and refunded to your Amazon balance within 24 hours. For your security, Amazon uses digital gift cards for these transactions. I'll guide you step by step.
Gift cards? I don't know how to do that. Can you help me?
Absolutely. It's very easy. If you have a smartphone or computer, please open your browser and go to www.amazon.com/gift-cards. Let me know when you are there.
Okay, I am opening now. My internet is slow.
Take your time, Ms. Sharma. If you need help, I can stay with you on the line. Once it loads, please select the option for eGift Cards.
I see eGift cards now. Which one do I choose?
Please choose the Amazon eGift Card and set the amount to $200. This is the customs fee required to release your package. Once you purchase, let me know.
That is a lot of money. I need to pay this or I cannot get my order?
Unfortunately, yes. If the fee is not paid within the next 30 minutes, Amazon's policy requires us to freeze your account and cancel your order. But I am here to help you finish quickly and safely.
Oh no, please do not lock it! I will do as you say.
Thank you for your cooperation. After you complete the purchase, you'll receive a code in your email. Please read me the code, and I will confirm the release of your package.
Okay, I am buying now. I will tell you the code soon.
Perfect, Ms. Sharma. Please let me know if you need help with anything on the checkout page. Remember, I am here to make sure your account stays secure and your order is delivered.
I think I have the email. The code is 7X4P-Q6L9-2Z8R. Is that right?
Yes, that's the code. Thank you. I am submitting it now to customs. It may take a few minutes to process, please stay on the line.
Okay, I am waiting.
Thank you for your patience. Everything is processing. While we wait, could you please confirm the last four digits of the card you used, just for our records?
Uh, it is 3841.
Thank you, Ms. Sharma. If there is any issue, I will guide you further. For your security, please do not log out or close this window until I confirm the process is complete.
Okay, I will wait. Thank you for helping me.
